app.name: NikTan
app.tagline: Your phone is the first checkup.
app.sub: Check your symptoms, prepare a health card and join the outpatient queue from your phone.
app.notDiagnosis: This is a screening, not a doctor's diagnosis.

common.offline: You are offline. The checks still work; results will sync later.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

landing.privacy: Your face and eye images never leave your phone.

consent.title: Before we begin
consent.onDeviceList: Face video, eye photos, vision and hearing tests
consent.uploadedList: Age, sex, pregnancy status, screening results and confirmed symptoms. Optional voice and meal photos go to speech or image providers. You can type, tap or enter dishes manually.
consent.notStoredList: Use symptoms only. Leave names, phone numbers and Aadhaar out of recordings, text and feedback.
consent.retention: Server records are cleared after 30 days by a daily cleanup. Use Delete my data on your card to erase your session earlier and clear the local copy.
consent.purpose: We use this information to prepare your screening card and show it to the hospital you choose when you join its queue.

info.title: A little about you
info.ageInvalid: Please enter an age between 0 and 120

voiceGuide.face: Hold the phone at arm’s length in even light. Keep your face inside the oval. Look straight ahead and stay still for thirty seconds.
voiceGuide.eye: In even light, look straight at the camera and take the first photo. For the second photo, gently pull down your lower eyelid, look up, and fit the red inner lid inside the box.
voiceGuide.vision: Place a card face down on the screen and match the guide to the short edge. Choose your testing distance, then cover one eye at a time. Tap the arrow that shows which way the E opens.
voiceGuide.hearing: Wear earphones in a quiet place. Check the left and right sounds first. You will hear three digits with noise. Enter the digits in the order you hear them.
voiceGuide.symptoms: Press and hold the microphone while you describe how you feel, then release it. You can also type or select symptoms. Check the list before you continue.

face.title: Heart rate from your face
face.instruction: Hold the phone at arm's length. Keep your face inside the circle and stay still.
face.light: Sit facing a window or light. Avoid light behind you.
face.noFace: Face not found. Move into the circle.
face.manyFaces: Keep only your face in the frame.
face.framing: Move closer so your face fills the guide.
face.lighting: Use even light across your forehead and cheeks.
face.tooDark: Too dark. Move into better light.
face.lowQuality: The reading was not clear. Try again in better light, or skip.
face.feel: Feel that? Your phone is tapping along with your pulse.

eye.title: Eye check
eye.instruction: Gently pull your lower eyelid down and look up. Keep the inner red part of the eyelid in the box.
eye.align: Place one lower eyelid in the centre of the box. Keep your whole face visible.
eye.torch: Turn on good light. Avoid coloured light.

vision.title: Vision test
vision.calibrate: Place a bank or Aadhaar card face down on the screen. Match the guide to the short edge.
vision.distance: Hold the phone 40 cm from your eyes. Wear your usual reading glasses if you use them.
vision.coverLeft: Cover your left eye without pressing
vision.coverRight: Cover your right eye without pressing
vision.instruction: Which way are the arms of the E pointing? Swipe or tap the arrow.
vision.tooClose: Move the phone a little further
vision.tooFar: Bring the phone a little closer
vision.helper: Measure 2 m from your eyes to the phone. Wear your usual distance glasses if you use them. Ask a helper to hold the phone and enter the direction you point.
vision.resolution: This screen cannot display the test clearly at 40 cm. Try the 2 m test.

hearing.title: Hearing test
hearing.earphones: Put on earphones and set the volume to a comfortable level. This test uses spoken Hindi digits.
hearing.leftRight: Do you hear the sound in the correct ear?
hearing.instruction: You will hear 3 numbers with noise. Type the numbers you hear.
hearing.missing: The hearing audio stopped or could not load. You can skip this step.
hearing.experimental: Experimental Hindi hearing screening. The cutoff is provisional.
hearing.adults: This experimental hearing screening is for adults.
hearing.unable: I couldn’t hear all three digits
hearing.confirmEars: I heard each tone in the matching ear

symptoms.title: What is troubling you?
symptoms.placeholder: e.g. fever for 3 days and cough
symptoms.micIssue: Speech could not be transcribed. You can type or select symptoms below.
symptoms.voiceNotice: Holding to speak sends a short audio clip for transcription. You can type or select symptoms below.
symptoms.browserFallback: If available, holding the microphone again uses your browser’s speech recognition service.

queue.near: Your turn is near. Please go to the counter.

thali.title: Scan your meal
thali.instruction: Photograph only the food. Choosing a photo sends it for dish recognition. You can also add dishes by hand.
thali.noFood: No food found in the photo.

home.sub: A 3-minute screening in the browser — heart rate from your face, eyes, vision, hearing and symptoms by voice — so the OPD knows who needs care first, before you reach the counter.
home.problemTitle: Two hours in a queue for five minutes with a doctor.
home.problemBody: OPDs are first-come, first-served. A breathless patient waits behind a routine follow-up, and the doctor spends the consult asking basics nobody measured.
home.stat1: average wait in a general-medicine OPD
home.statSource: Published Indian OPD time-motion studies; see README for sources.
home.howTitle: Five checks. One verdict. Zero guesswork.

steps.d: The camera reads tiny colour changes in your skin with every heartbeat. A signal-quality gate rejects bad light and movement.
A look at the inner eyelid flags possible anaemia; the sclera and pupil add experimental jaundice and cataract flags.
A tumbling-E chart sized to your exact screen with a bank card, one eye at a time.
Spoken Hindi digits in noise — the same method as WHO hearWHO — adaptively find your hearing threshold.
Speak in Hindi or Hinglish. Words become symptom chips you confirm. Danger signs are asked once, never assumed.

home.bentoTitle: Serious engineering behind a three-minute check.
home.b1t: Your face never leaves your phone
home.b1d: Video, eye photos, vision and hearing are processed on-device. Only numbers and flags are sent.
home.b2d: Priority comes from a versioned, unit-tested rule engine. AI only turns speech into structured fields.
home.b3d: Offline-first PWA. Scan steps keep working when the venue Wi‑Fi doesn't.
home.b4d: Hindi by default, Chhattisgarhi greetings, English when you want it, voice guidance throughout.
home.b5d: Photograph your plate; nutrition from the Indian Nutrient Databank and local swaps like lal bhaji and kulthi.
home.b6d: Red-flag answers skip the queue entirely: Call 108, go to Emergency.
home.hospTitle: The OPD knows you before you arrive.
home.hospBody: A live triage board sorts every department by priority, then arrival. Doctors open a pre-consult card instead of starting from zero.
home.privBody: No name, phone number or Aadhaar is ever asked. Delete your data with one tap. Built around India's DPDP Act.
home.endSub: How are you feeling? Find out in three minutes.
home.footer: NikTan screens and prioritises. It never diagnoses. In an emergency call 108.
